text: Laamu ngun Ñalnde Darngal -Ñalnde ko ɓee wonanoo fodeede kon immorde e Lepte ɗen arata ko Alla tun heeranii, O alaa pooɗondirteeɗo e ɗum,Kanko O Senike hiMo Ñaawa hakkunde gomɗinɓe ɓen e yeduɓe ɓen, O Ñaawana mo kala e maɓɓe ko o hanndi kon e mu'un, ɓen gomɗinɓe Alla ɓe golli golle moƴƴe ɗen no woodani ɓe mbar- jaari mawndi ɗum ko Aljannaaji Neema duumiiɗo on mo taƴataa.
